title: anthyllis alpicola
intro: Anthyllis alpicola, commonly known as mountain kidney-vetch, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support urinary health and alleviate symptoms of kidney stones, due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Anthyllis alpicola include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and to promote the elimination of waste products from the body, making it a valuable remedy for conditions such as nephrolithiasis and urolithiasis. The bioactive constituents of Anthyllis alpicola include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and make it a valuable source of natural medicine.
